mapper.select: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') AS month, COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0) AS amount FROM sales_order WHERE status = 3 AND create_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{months} MONTH) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month ASC
SELECT status AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM sales_order GROUP BY status ORDER BY status

SELECT soi.product_name AS name, COALESCE(SUM(soi.quantity), 0) AS value FROM sales_order_item soi JOIN sales_order so ON soi.order_id = so.id WHERE so.status = 3 GROUP BY soi.product_id, soi.product_name ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT #{top}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM production_order WHERE status = 2
SELECT product_name AS name, COALESCE(SUM(quantity), 0) AS value FROM production_order GROUP BY product_id, product_name ORDER BY value DESC
SELECT status AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM production_order GROUP BY status ORDER BY status

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') AS month, COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0) AS amount FROM purchase_order WHERE status = 3 AND create_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{months} MONTH) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month ASC
SELECT status AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM purchase_order GROUP BY status ORDER BY status
SELECT product_name AS name, (stock * price) AS value FROM product WHERE status = 1 ORDER BY value DESC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS day, SUM(CASE WHEN change_type = 'IN' THEN change_quantity ELSE 0 END) AS in_qty, SUM(CASE WHEN change_type = 'OUT' THEN change_quantity ELSE 0 END) AS out_qty FROM inventory_record WHERE create_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY day ASC

SELECT p.product_name AS name, p.stock AS value, COALESCE(sac.min_stock, 0) AS threshold FROM product p LEFT JOIN stock_alert_config sac ON p.id = sac.product_id AND sac.alert_enabled = 1 WHERE p.status = 1 AND p.stock < COALESCE(sac.min_stock, 0) ORDER BY (COALESCE(sac.min_stock, 0) - p.stock) DESC
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0) FROM sales_order WHERE status = 3 AND DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m')
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(stock * price), 0) FROM product WHERE status = 1
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sales_order WHERE status = 0) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM purchase_order WHERE status = 0) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM production_order WHERE status = 0)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product p JOIN stock_alert_config sac ON p.id = sac.product_id WHERE p.status = 1 AND sac.alert_enabled = 1 AND p.stock < sac.min_stock
